import json, os, time
from pathlib import Path
from app import config
root = Path(os.environ["ALERT_TEST_CASE"])
config.VAR_DIR = root / "var"
from app import alerts, monitor
from app.db import init_db, connect, now_iso
from app.settings import set_settings, get_ai_settings
from app.service import provider_configuration_fingerprint
init_db()
set_settings({"ai_provider": "openai_codex", "kimi_model": "fixture-model",
    "alert_email": "info@instacast.ch", "alert_cooldown_seconds": "3600",
    "alert_enabled": "0" if root.name == "disabled" else "1", "ai_monthly_limit_usd": "0"})
(config.VAR_DIR / "codex-models.json").write_text(json.dumps({"models": [
    {"slug": "fixture-model", "apply_patch_tool_type": None, "input_modalities": ["text"]}]}))
if root.name == "runtime":
    set_settings({"transcription_provider_block": json.dumps({
        "configuration": provider_configuration_fingerprint(get_ai_settings()),
        "until": time.time() + 600, "message": "Provider rejected processing"})})
if root.name == "failed_job":
    with connect() as con:
        con.execute("INSERT INTO jobs(job_type,status,error,created_at,updated_at) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?)",
            ("transcribe", "failed", "Audio download failed", now_iso(), now_iso()))
alerts.SENDMAIL = root / "bin" / "sendmail"
if root.name == "resource_only":
    alerts.send_operational_alerts(cpu_total_percent=0, load_1m=0,
        mem_available_gib=100, resource_only=True)
else:
    monitor.main()
